title: step-tests/status.yaml
description: Per-step-unit workflow status for Phase 21's spec-conformance JUnit test coverage (see cdsi-engine/AGENTS.md). Pass/fail/error/skipped counts are never stored here - step_test_status.py always reads those live from cdsi-engine's surefire reports - so this file only ever holds what a test run can't tell you. Cross-field rules (blocked_category/blocked_reason required exactly when fix_status is blocked, test_class required exactly when test_status is tests_written) are enforced by step_test_status.validate_status, not by this schema.

units.description: Keyed the same way as mappings/spec-to-code.yaml: a spec section number (e.g. "8.6") or an unmapped_classes enum name (e.g. "EVALUATE_GENDER").

test_status.description: not_started: Role A hasn't written this unit's spec-conformance test class yet. tests_written: it exists and is merged - red and green cases are both expected here, this tracks coverage, not correctness.

test_class.description: Fully-qualified JUnit test class name (e.g. "org.openimmunizationsoftware.cdsi.core.logic.NoValidDosesCompletableTest"). Null iff test_status is not_started.

fix_status.description: not_started/in_progress: Role B hasn't finished this round. fixed_pending_review: Role B believes every test in this unit's class is green with zero regressions elsewhere, awaiting the project owner's merge. merged: reviewed and merged. blocked: Role B stopped without committing a fix - see blocked_category/blocked_reason.

blocked_category.description: Required (non-null) iff fix_status is blocked; null otherwise. would_regress_other_tests: making this unit's tests pass would break another currently-green JUnit test or an allowlisted FITS case. upstream_step_defect: the real defect appears to live in a different step's class (recorded in a finding's code_locations) - Role B must never fix another step's code itself, only report it. undetermined: ran out of evidence.

blocked_reason.description: Required (non-null, non-empty) iff fix_status is blocked: what would break, or which upstream class is suspected and the evidence for it. Null otherwise.

finding_ids.description: SPEC-<version>-NNNN findings raised while working this unit, including ones filed against a different unit's code_locations (see upstream_step_defect).
